title: AR-11
subtitle: Aliens Change of Address Card
description: Non-citizens use Form AR-11 to notify USCIS of an address change.

title: DS-160
subtitle: Online Nonimmigrant Visa Application
description: Travelers applying for a temporary U.S. visa must complete Form DS-160 online. It collects key personal and travel details and is submitted electronically before the visa interview.

title: G-1145
subtitle: E-Notification of Application/Petition Acceptance
description: Applicants and petitioners use Form G-1145 to request a text message and/or email when USCIS accepts their form.

title: G-1450
subtitle: Authorization for Credit Card Transactions
description: Applicants and petitioners use Form G-1450 to authorize USCIS to charge filing fees to a credit card.

title: G-1650
subtitle: Authorization for ACH Transactions
description: Applicants and petitioners use Form G-1650 to authorize USCIS to charge filing fees through an ACH transaction.

title: I-129F
subtitle: K-1 Visa Petition Package
description: U.S. citizens may prepare Form I-129F (Petition for Alien Fiancé) to petition USCIS to bring a fiancé(e) to the U.S. for marriage and adjustment of status. Also used to petition for a spouse's K-3 visa.

title: I-130
subtitle: Immigrant Visa Petition Package
description: U.S. citizens, nationals, and permanent residents use Form I-130 (Petition for Alien Relative) to help a family member obtain a green card.

title: I-130A
subtitle: Supplemental Information for Spouse Beneficiary
description: Used by spouse beneficiary to submit supplemental information with Form I-130. This form is included with the Immigrant Visa Petition Package.

title: I-131
subtitle: Travel Document Package
description: Certain individuals use Form I-131 (Application for Travel Documents, Parole Documents, and Arrival/Departure Records) to obtain a Reentry Permit, Advance Parole, and other documents.

title: I-131A
subtitle: Carrier Documentation Package
description: Permanent residents whose green card or reentry permit is lost, stolen, or destroyed while abroad use Form I-131A (Application for Carrier Documentation) to obtain temporary travel documentation.

title: I-134
subtitle: Non-immigrant Support Package
description: Individuals may use Form I-134 (Declaration of Financial Support) to financially support a non-immigrant visitor to the United States.

title: ETA-9089
subtitle: Application for Permanent Employment Certification
description: Employers use Form ETA-9089 to request permanent labor certification for employment-based immigrant visa sponsorship.

title: ETA-9141
subtitle: Application for Prevailing Wage Determination
description: Employers use Form ETA-9141 to request a prevailing wage determination for PERM and other employment-based filings.

title: I-140
subtitle: Immigrant Petition for Alien Workers
description: Employers and eligible self-petitioners use Form I-140 to petition USCIS for employment-based immigrant worker classification.

title: G-28
subtitle: Notice of Entry of Appearance
description: Attorneys and accredited representatives use Form G-28 to notify USCIS that they represent an applicant, petitioner, or respondent.

title: I-907
subtitle: Request for Premium Processing Service
description: Applicants and petitioners use Form I-907 to request premium processing for eligible immigration benefit requests.

title: I-485
subtitle: Adjustment of Status Package
description: Non-citizens use Form I-485 (Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status) to apply for permanent resident status and obtain a green card. Includes Form I-130 for concurrent family-based applications.

title: I-751
subtitle: Removal of Conditions Petition Package
description: Conditional residents who obtained status through marriage use Form I-751 (Petition to Remove Conditions on Residence) to remove conditions and obtain a permanent 10-year green card.

title: I-765
subtitle: Employment Authorization Package
description: Eligible individuals use Form I-765 (Application for Employment Authorization) to obtain an initial, renewal, or replacement Employment Authorization Document (EAD), also known as a work permit.

title: I-821D
subtitle: DACA Application Package
description: Certain individuals use Form I-821D (Consideration of Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals) to apply for an initial or renewal grant of DACA. Includes all mandatory forms (I-821D, I-765, and I-765WS).

title: I-864
subtitle: Immigrant Affidavit of Support Package
description: U.S. citizens, nationals, or permanent residents use Form I-864 (Affidavit of Support) to financially sponsor a relative for a green card.

title: I-864A
subtitle: Contract Between Sponsor and Household Member
description: Certain household members may contribute to income used on Form I-864 by submitting Form I-864A. Must be completed as an add-on to our I-864 service.

title: I-90
subtitle: Green Card Renewal/Replacement Package
description: Permanent residents use Form I-90 (Application to Replace Permanent Resident Card) to replace or renew a green card.

title: N-400
subtitle: Naturalization Package
description: Permanent residents use Form N-400 (Application for Naturalization) to apply for U.S. citizenship through naturalization.

title: N-565
subtitle: Citizenship Document Replacement Package
description: U.S. citizens use Form N-565 (Application for Replacement Naturalization/Citizenship Document) to replace a previously issued Certificate of Naturalization or Certificate of Citizenship.

title: N-600
subtitle: Citizenship Certificate Package
description: Individuals who gained citizenship through parents use Form N-600 (Application for Certificate of Citizenship) to request a Certificate of Citizenship.
